Name: Luny's Cute Swamp Buildings for AT and CP
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/2mjbfye.png[/img]
This mod changes the farm buildings into new dusty pink & lavender colored versions complete with cute foliage and moss! 

Not all buildings have retextures yet, but I decided to go ahead and release what I have finished since so many people have asked about them. Available for Content Patcher and Alternative Textures!

The bushes on the Greenhouse are from Simple Foliage, so credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/73472878]dugongkebalik[/url] for those!


[b][color=#d5a6bd]Buildings included in this pack:[/color][/b]
Farmhouse (all three stages)
Greenhouse
Barn (all stages)
Coop (all stages)
Stable
Silo
Mill
Slime Hutch
SVE - Premium Barn
SVE - Premium Coop
SVE - Winery


[b][color=#d5a6bd]Buildings to be added later: [/color][/b]
Shed & Big Shed
Junimo Hut
Obelisks
Gold Clock
Fish Pond
Pet Bowl
Shipping Bin
Mailbox
Well
Multiplayer Cabins
Tractor Garage


I have a lot on my plate right now, so I'm not sure when exactly I'll be adding the other bulidings, but I definitely want this to be a complete set!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/wvlMKlE.png[/img]﻿

Extract the downloaded file and move the folder into your StardewValley/Mods folder. Done!




Thanks for checking out my mods!
